title: Podcast Advertising Guide: Native Reads vs. Host-Read vs. Produced Spots - Matinée Multilingual

facts.fact: The Matinée Multilingual podcast advertising guide is dated January 5, 2026.
The guide's comparison table lists a typical length of 60–120 seconds for host-read ads.
facts.quote: Typical Length | 60–120 seconds | 15–30 seconds | 5–15 minutes (or full episode)

facts.fact: The guide's comparison table lists a typical length of 15–30 seconds for produced spots.
facts.quote: Typical Length | 60–120 seconds | 15–30 seconds | 5–15 minutes (or full episode)

facts.fact: The guide's comparison table lists a typical length of 5–15 minutes (or a full episode) for native branded content.
facts.quote: Typical Length | 60–120 seconds | 15–30 seconds | 5–15 minutes (or full episode)

facts.fact: The guide describes produced spots as pre-recorded, professionally mixed audio ads typically lasting 15-30 seconds.
The guide states that host-read ads carry a higher CPM and cost due to host equity.
facts.quote: Higher CPM/cost due to host equity.

facts.fact: The guide's table rates produced spots as having the lowest to medium CPM cost, while host-read ads are rated highest.
facts.quote: Cost (CPM) | Highest | Lowest to Medium | Project-Based / Highest

facts.fact: The guide states that mid-roll ad placement delivers the highest engagement due to lower skip rates.
facts.quote: with mid-roll delivering the highest engagement due to lower skip rates.

facts.fact: The guide's table rates host-read ads as having low scalability (per-show basis) and produced spots as having high scalability (programmatic/DAI).
facts.quote: Scalability | Low (Per-Show Basis) | High (Programmatic/DAI) | Very Low (Custom Production)
